writeMethod: Direct single-parent master commit, force=false. No pull request, staging branch or additional workflow. Current Prism and all other sibling source preserved relative to parent.
changedPathScope: Sixteen paths: Neighborhood source, tests and documentation, plus ordering of cases in its two existing verification workflows. No test removed and all 19 source, eight console-mode and 21 public journeys retained.

implementation.gold: The actual current mission destination remains marked.
implementation.cyan: An advisory WAY IN marker, compass direction and dashed map line identify an existing public entrance or supported floor transition.
implementation.stateAwareness: Advice respects the current canal water and blue-door state. Existing saved shortcuts remain useful. The field card explains stairs, dismounting and docking.
implementation.limits: Static walking advice, not an enemy/traffic avoidance system or lift-timing guarantee. No automatic steering, teleporting, progression, reward, route unlock or geometry change. Unknown support retains the final task with an explicit fallback hint.
implementation.presentation: Existing full-city and Lantern Ward integration, eight native XR modes, floor/controller console, trigger choices and hidden normal-play menus remain. New entrance cues are in Lantern Ward, not an unimplemented city-wide navigation rewrite.

publication.independentVerification: Downloaded the actual public-byte report and independently recomputed every expected source hash. All 317 served requests match the exact local game/design files; zero mismatches. JavaScript MIME types and the directory entry are included. This is not a deployment inference from source tests.

sourceVerification.storyTestScope: Normal tick/action movement, interaction and exactly-once rewards after serialization/reload. Separate water/gate/boat model fixtures are not represented as a fresh rendered playthrough.
sourceVerification.renderedScope: Local full-game WebGL was unavailable. Hosted source/public browser journeys are independent, with no complete rendered approval claimed at this recording.

revealingFailures.scope: First draft of this guidance, before publication

revealingFailures.repair: Replace straight diagonal height interpolation with actual stepped support and directed links. Five full stories and a specific descending-landing regression now pass without changing geometry or progress rules.

revealingFailures.failure: The game had correctly reported No backup available, but the driver read innerText from the deliberately hidden desktop toast.
revealingFailures.repair: Read textContent, which nativeMenuDescription actually uses. Keep the error-feedback and no-destructive-confirmation assertions. The earlier failed run stays failed.

unportedFeaturesUnchanged: Signal City cars/drone/Waterfront File and Tideglass indoor swimming are still separate unported work, not claimed delivered by Way In.
recovery: Resume from current master, AGENTS.md and WAYFINDING.md. Preserve current saved preferences, layout identities, original archive, independent reward ledgers and sibling changes. This external receipt does not modify any verified game file or require a recursive game deployment.
